Roof repair, replacement, and exterior work for homes in Macungie and the Lehigh Valley.

A roof or exterior problem in the Lehigh Valley usually shows up after a storm or during a routine inspection, and it rarely waits for a convenient time to get fixed. Advance Exterior Solutions works on homes in and around Macungie, handling roofing, siding, and other exterior repairs and replacements. The focus stays on a clear inspection, an honest explanation of what's needed, and work that holds up through the next season of weather.
Repair work for leaks, missing shingles, and storm damage, starting with a straightforward inspection of the actual problem area. Homeowners get a plain explanation before any work begins.

Full roof replacement for homeowners dealing with an aging or failing roof, using materials suited to the Lehigh Valley climate. The old roof comes off and the new one goes on in a scheduled, single project.
Siding repair and installation to protect a home's exterior and keep it looking sharp from the street. Damaged sections get replaced without redoing a whole wall unnecessarily.
Inspections after wind, hail, or storm events to identify roof and exterior damage before it turns into a bigger repair. The assessment covers the roof, siding, and trim together.
Gutter and trim work to round out an exterior project and keep water moving away from the home properly. Trim gets checked for rot and weather damage during any roof or siding job.
Tell us what you're seeing, a leak, missing shingles, storm damage, or aging siding, and where on the house it is.
A walkthrough of the roof, siding, and trim to find the actual cause, not just the visible symptom.
What's needed, what it involves, and why, before any work starts on your home.
Repair or replacement scheduled and completed, with a final look to confirm the fix holds up.
